# Independent workbook import fixtures

These files are unchanged Apache POI test data from `test-data/spreadsheet` at
upstream revision `732120980140d5ed64b482c470e0b625cdb1ab15`, licensed under
Apache-2.0. They were not generated by Poirot and were not normalized for calamine.
The fixtures are stored here directly; no separate upstream checkout is required.

| File | Original SHA-256 | Primary expectation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| poi-SimpleMultiCell.xls | f8f04c014b7503e62fa52c3b194dfaf010140a36298764d07dd9d1837ab1d037 | Original three-sheet sparse values and empty-sheet import. |
| poi-SimpleMultiCell.xlsx | 119b6e70c5bbca6ca3e46f981e0719c154d87203adb4b5b61210d726deab9f7a | OOXML counterpart for the same import contract. |
| poi-StringFormulas.xls | 9f628ae749ce976a408aa211025b5a6a0c906393f7e9d2cdd807f03449d20ce3 | POI TestFormulas.testStringFormulas asserts sheet 0 A1 formula `UPPER("xyz")`; overlay tests additionally inspect original StringPtg bytes. |
| poi-unicodeNameRecord.xls | 765b85f757704b89edfc6aa476c202685173a90a2b6a6b0d74519c924b4c5624 | POI TestUnicodeNameRecord.testReadBook asserts import does not crash and sheet 0 exists. This is only an import smoke test, not a stronger unverified semantic claim. |

The bounded reader follows pinned POI StringPtg, NameRecord, RefPtgBase, AreaPtgBase, Ref3DPtg and StringRecord layouts. Its function ID/arity table derives from `poi/src/main/resources/org/apache/poi/ss/formula/function/functionMetadata.txt`, SHA-256 `37687034933e826811fde5eae5eb56c9ff0d630ee4c598370037c3f716a14654`.

Inline independent byte fixtures in biff_overlay.rs retain a permissive CODEPAGE-1252 source with valid UTF16 `ΣA`/`σA` BOUNDSHEET records; original codepage, encoding flag, and code units are asserted. Import uses original overlay sheet identities while querying the backend by its decoded spelling. Other text decoded by the backend under a non-UTF16 codepage retains a warning. The fixtures also verify surrogate pairs, compressed-to-wide STRING CONTINUE, mixed endpoint-relative AreaPtg flags, XTI quoting, and duplicate local Unicode NAME identities/scopes. Those fixtures assert original record bytes and production `read_xls_bytes` results. Calamine receives an isolated same-size Workbook stream view for supported tokens; the source CFB and oracle input bytes remain unchanged.

Unsupported token families retain warnings; BIFF8 overlay coverage does not establish complete XLS compatibility.

## Additional import regressions

`stale-cache.xlsx` is an authored OOXML fixture demonstrating that loading does not
recalculate formula caches. `libreoffice-recalculated.xlsx` is an unchanged output
from LibreOffice Calc, retained to test its typed error/string cache channels.
Neither file establishes complete Excel compatibility.

`generated-xls/` contains ROI-generated record probes, described in its
[provenance note](generated-xls/PROVENANCE.md). They are writer/reader regressions,
separate from the independent Apache POI input fixtures above.
